title: Special Assets | Non-Performing & Special-Situations Servicing | Veteran Loan Servicing
description: Special assets servicing for non-performing and special-situations commercial loans: tight breach-to-action timing, documented workflows, and UCC Article 9 triggers.
h1: Special assets — where timing is the product
lede: For non-performing and special-situations commercial paper, the difference between recovery and loss is timing. We treat special assets as a servicing discipline with a documented trail, not an afterthought.

sections.heading: Process
paragraphs: Special-situations and non-performing loans get tighter monitoring: breach signals are surfaced early, remediation steps are tracked, and UCC Article 9 enforcement triggers are documented so action is timely.
bullets: Early breach detection on watch-list loans
Coordination with the lender's workout counsel

sections.heading: Controls
paragraphs: Breach-to-action timing is driven by the operating trail rather than a quarterly report, and each step is documented so the special-asset file holds up.

sections.heading: Reporting
paragraphs: Watch-list and special-asset status appear in portfolio reporting, and the documented trail supports the lender's counsel and LP or examiner review.

sections.heading: Benefits
paragraphs: Performing books benefit from early detection; special-situations and NPL portfolios benefit most from tight breach-to-action timing and a clean, documented trail.

faqs.q: What counts as a special asset?
faqs.a: Non-performing or special-situations commercial loans that need tighter monitoring and a faster path from breach signal to remediation.
